headline: STL @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is STL 4.03 at OAK 3.84, with a projected total of 7.87. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: STL moved -1.06 runs while OAK moved -0.52, changing the projected margin by -0.54 runs. The projected total fell -1.58, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +38.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jeffrey Springs has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Jacob Wilson, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Pedro Pagés because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
